name: Acid Salt
body:
School evocation [acid]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (ground stone dust)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area cylinder (30 ft./level radius, 100 ft. high)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell creates a vast area of airborne corrosive salts that deal 1d3+1 points of acid damage to creatures and objects.
